trigger_text: Refactor Stata do-files while preserving every final output exactly — datasets (datasignature + schema identical), parameter estimates (bit-identical e(b)/e(V)/scalars via %21x), graphs (content-equivalent: plotted data + command string), and tables (text-normalized, timestamps stripped). Use when restructuring, reorganizing, modularizing, or cleaning up a do-file and the results must not change at all — the output-preserving counterpart to stata-modernize, which optimizes and accepts behavior risk. Mandates a golden-master snapshot/compare harness and forbids touching estimation commands, their options, the estimation sample, or analysis-variable construction.
short_description: Restructure Stata do-files while preserving every final output exactly; mandates a golden-master harness and forbids touching estimation commands/options.
default_prompt: Use the stata-sam-refactor skill to restructure a Stata do-file while guaranteeing identical final datasets, estimates, graphs, and tables via a golden-master snapshot/compare harness.
